title: Align federation status facade label handling with utilization source bounds
outcome: A utilization label accepted by its existing source does not unnecessarily remove resource observations for unrelated hosts from the agent facade, while the facade retains its path-redaction and size guarantees.
acceptance: Reconcile utilization architecture label acceptance with the source's 256-byte non-control label contract; preserve the read-only scope and path/credential redaction requirements.

Fixture-only behavioral tests cover a valid 129–256-byte architecture and the chosen slash/path treatment, including unaffected hosts and observable availability. No new sampler, network/process tests or source-text tests.
